title: Position Display
text: The SFMC shall display the spacecraft's current position to the pilot.

title: Navigation Update
text: The SFMC shall update the displayed spacecraft position at least once every 500 milliseconds while the spacecraft is in Manual Flight, Autopilot, or Combat mode.

title: Destination Selection
text: The SFMC shall allow the pilot to select a navigation destination.

title: Route Calculation
text: When the pilot selects a destination, the SFMC shall calculate a safe and efficient route to the destination.
findings: safe and efficient: Define safety and efficiency criteria.

title: Autopilot
text: When Autopilot mode is enabled, the SFMC shall control the spacecraft propulsion system to follow the selected route.

title: Autopilot Arrival
text: The autopilot shall deliver the spacecraft reasonably close to the selected destination.
findings: reasonably close: Define an acceptable arrival distance.

title: Engine Status
text: The SFMC shall continuously monitor the status of the spacecraft's main engines.

title: Fuel Warning
text: The SFMC shall display a low-fuel warning when remaining fuel falls below 15 percent of usable fuel capacity.

title: Critical Fuel Warning
text: When remaining fuel falls below 5 percent of usable fuel capacity, the SFMC shall display a critical-fuel warning and generate an audible alarm.

title: Engine Failure
text: If the SFMC detects a failure of a main engine, it shall notify the pilot and take appropriate corrective action.
findings: appropriate corrective action: Define the required corrective action.

title: Target Detection
text: The SFMC shall display detected spacecraft within sensor range.

title: Target Selection
text: The SFMC shall allow the pilot to designate a detected spacecraft as a target.

title: Target Information
text: For a selected target, the SFMC shall display: - relative distance, - relative velocity, - target classification, and - targeting status.

title: Weapons Authorization
text: The SFMC shall prevent a weapon from firing unless the pilot has authorized weapons operation.

title: Friendly Spacecraft
text: The SFMC shall never permit the pilot to fire a weapon at a friendly spacecraft.
findings: friendly spacecraft: Define the criteria for identifying friendly, hostile, or unknown spacecraft.

title: Targeting Performance
text: The targeting system shall be extremely accurate.
findings: extremely accurate: Define the accuracy metric and limit.

title: Threat Warning
text: When the Defensive System identifies an incoming threat, the SFMC shall display a threat warning to the pilot.

title: Threat Priority
text: The SFMC shall clearly indicate which incoming threat represents the greatest danger to the spacecraft.
findings: greatest danger: Define the threat-priority factors and ranking method.

title: Shield Activation
text: When the spacecraft enters Combat mode, the SFMC shall activate the defensive shields.

title: Automatic Countermeasures
text: The SFMC shall automatically deploy countermeasures against incoming guided weapons when automatic defense is enabled.

title: Defensive Response
text: The SFMC shall respond quickly to dangerous threats.
findings: quickly: Specify a measurable response-time limit.

title: Message Transmission
text: The SFMC shall allow the pilot to transmit messages to fleet command.

title: Message Reception
text: The SFMC shall notify the pilot when a new fleet message is received.

title: Emergency Message
text: The SFMC shall allow the pilot to designate an outgoing message as an emergency message.

title: Secure Communications
text: All important communications shall be securely encrypted.
findings: important: Identify exactly which data or communications are covered. | securely encrypted: Identify the applicable encryption requirements.

title: Subsystem Monitoring
text: The SFMC shall monitor the health of the Navigation, Propulsion, Weapons, Defensive, and Communications systems.

title: Fault Display
text: When a monitored subsystem reports a fault, the SFMC shall display the affected subsystem and the reported fault to the pilot within 1 second.

title: Fault Log
text: The SFMC shall record detected spacecraft faults in a mission fault log.

title: Fault Log Contents
text: For each recorded fault, the mission fault log shall contain: - fault identifier, - affected subsystem, - time of detection, and - fault description.

title: Critical Faults
text: The SFMC shall immediately notify the pilot of all critical faults.
findings: immediately: Clarify the maximum allowed response time.

title: Emergency Mode
text: The pilot shall be able to place the SFMC into Emergency mode using a dedicated cockpit control.

title: Emergency Priorities
text: While operating in Emergency mode, the SFMC shall prioritize life-support, navigation, and propulsion functions over nonessential spacecraft functions.
findings: nonessential spacecraft functions: Identify the functions that may be delayed or disabled in Emergency mode.

title: Emergency Navigation
text: If the spacecraft is seriously damaged, the SFMC shall automatically determine the safest destination.
findings: seriously damaged: Define the condition that triggers this behavior. | safest destination: Define destination selection criteria.

title: Emergency Autopilot
text: The SFMC shall be capable of automatically flying the spacecraft to a safe location during an emergency.
findings: safe location: Define what qualifies as a safe location.

title: Pilot Override
text: The pilot shall always be able to override automatic spacecraft controls.

title: Startup Time
text: The SFMC shall become operational within 30 seconds after spacecraft computer power is applied.

title: Pilot Command Response
text: The SFMC shall respond to pilot commands without noticeable delay.
findings: without noticeable delay: Response time is subjective.

title: Display Update
text: During normal operation, the SFMC shall update flight information displayed to the pilot at least 10 times per second.

title: Mission Duration
text: The SFMC shall operate continuously for missions lasting up to 72 hours.

title: Software Failure
text: The SFMC software shall never crash during a mission.

title: Fault Recovery
text: If a recoverable software fault occurs, the SFMC shall recover automatically without requiring pilot intervention.

title: Data Preservation
text: Recovery from a software fault shall not cause the loss of important mission data.
findings: important: Identify exactly which data or communications are covered.

title: Degraded Operation
text: If a spacecraft subsystem becomes unavailable, the SFMC shall continue operating using the remaining available systems whenever possible.
findings: whenever possible: Define when continued operation is required.

title: Mission Log
text: The SFMC shall maintain a mission log.

title: Mission Log Events
text: The mission log shall record: - changes in operating mode, - pilot commands, - detected faults, - weapons firing events, - emergency events, and - communications with fleet command.

title: Event Time
text: Each mission-log entry shall include the spacecraft mission time at which the event occurred.

title: Log Capacity
text: The mission log shall contain sufficient storage for an entire mission.
findings: sufficient storage: Define storage capacity or the expected workload.

title: Pilot Authentication
text: The SFMC shall verify that the pilot is authorized before enabling spacecraft operation.

title: Unauthorized Commands
text: The SFMC shall reject unauthorized commands received through the spacecraft communications system.

title: Security
text: The SFMC shall use state-of-the-art security techniques to protect the spacecraft from cyberattack.
findings: state-of-the-art: Identify the applicable security criteria.

title: Hardware Platform
text: The SFMC software shall execute on the Starhawk Flight Computer.

title: Network Interface
text: The SFMC shall communicate with spacecraft subsystems using the Starhawk spacecraft data network.

title: Software Updates
text: Authorized maintenance personnel shall be able to install updated SFMC software while the spacecraft is in Standby mode.

title: Update Integrity
text: The SFMC shall verify the integrity and authenticity of a software update before installing it.
